articles.summary: LITEON is collaborating with Wolfspeed to leverage silicon carbide MOSFETs for its next-generation 800 VDC sidecar power platform, targeting leading hyperscale customers and future design opportunities.
articles.title: Wolfspeed and LITEON Partner to Support Hyperscale AI Data Center Deployments with 800 VDC Power Solutions | Wolfspeed
